description: Verification script to test that recently-built enrichment modules (tool_description_safety_enrichment.py, permission_scope_enrichment.py, temporal_stability_enrichment.py, community_signal_enrichment.py) can produce at least 20 distinct scores across the 34-fingerprint synthetic corpus defined in enrichment_harness.py. Run compute_score() against each fingerprint and assert len(distinct_scores) >= 20 per module. This addresses the weak-signal diagnostic where these 3 signals show only 4 distinct values across all inputs. Exits 0 on pass, non-zero with diagnostic output on failure.
